title: Psalms 128
paragraphs: ¹ Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in obedience to him. ² You will eat the fruit of your labor; blessings and prosperity will be yours. ³ Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house; your children like olive shoots around your table. ⁴ Yes, this is how the man who fears the LORD will be blessed. ⁵ May the LORD bless you from Zion; may you see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
⁶ May you live to see your children's children — and peace upon Israel.
